# Vinsa Electric (PT. Anugerah Tama Sejati)

> Vinsa Electric is a premier Indonesian manufacturer and distributor of high-quality industrial and residential electrical components, switchgear, distribution boxes, and automation controls.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name**: Vinsa Electric (Vinsa)
- **Legal Entity**: PT. Anugerah Tama Sejati
- **Website**: https://vinsa.co.id
- **Headquarters**: Galaxy Bumi Permai J1-23, Sukolilo, Surabaya, Jawa Timur 60119, Indonesia
- **Contact Email**: sales@ATstekno.com
- **Customer Support & WhatsApp**: +62 813-3571-5398

## Core Product Categories
- [Push Button & Selector Switches](https://vinsa.co.id/product/push-button): Industrial push button switches (flush, illuminated, emergency stop, rotary selector switches).
- [Box Panel & Enclosures](https://vinsa.co.id/product/box-panel): Weatherproof metal and ABS distribution boxes, electrical enclosure cabinets, modular junction boxes.
- [Circuit Breakers (MCB / MCCB)](https://vinsa.co.id/product/mcb-mccb): Miniature Circuit Breakers (1P, 2P, 3P, 4P) and Molded Case Circuit Breakers for electrical overload and short-circuit protection.
- [Magnetic Contactors & Overload Relays](https://vinsa.co.id/product/contactor): AC Contactors (9A to 630A) and Thermal Overload Relays for motor control and industrial automation.
- [Pilot Lamps & Indicators](https://vinsa.co.id/product/pilot-lamp): LED panel indicator lights, buzzers, and signal lamps (22mm, 220V/24V).
- [Terminal Blocks & Busbars](https://vinsa.co.id/product/terminal-block): DIN-rail terminal blocks, copper busbars, and distribution blocks.

## Locations & Showrooms
